title: Order Header
description: Header-level structure shared by every order and sub-order: identity, lineage, target, and status. An order's positions (line items) are defined separately - see order-position.schema.json. This schema describes the SHAPE order/sub-order instances must have; actual live instances are runtime data (in the WMS/OMS), not tracked in this repo - see structure/fields.yaml for how one order_type restricts/extends this shape.

order_type.description: References the order_type this header belongs to.

parent_order_id.description: Empty/absent for a top-level order. Set for a sub-order created by a split_rule, or spawned by a completion_rule's spawn_order action.

source_split_rule.description: References the split_rule.id that created this sub-order, if any.

status.description: References a statuses[].id from this order_type's structure/status.yaml.

target.description: The destination this order/sub-order must reach. References a Warehouse-as-Code entity - decided once at order/sub-order creation time (by the runtime OMS/WMS), not re-resolved dynamically here. A sub-order's target may differ from its parent's (e.g. an AutoStore sub-order's target is the cell's own EXIT work_center, not the parent's outbound door) - see docs/entity-glossary.md.

type.description: The Warehouse-as-Code entity kind this target references.

id.description: The Warehouse-as-Code id of the door/work_center/activity_area.
